name: great_inflation_start
description: when a Great Inflation-style stretch begins: anywhere from 2031 (after normalization_start) to 2064, so a scenario ending before 2064 has no episode in some members; override it by name to place the episode

name: great_inflation_end
description: when it ends: 8 to 17 years after it begins (1966-1982 ran 17; its worst, 1973-1981, 9)
